description: This seraphic super soft throw/blanket is presented by CaliTime, a symbolic of modern fashionable home textiles.
Machine wash cold separately. Gentle cycle only. No bleach. Tumble dry low. Do not iron.

The plush flannel coral fleece throw can be used as auxiliary blanket to keep warmth during spring and autumn, and will be perfect blanket during summer in air-conditioned room; the fluffy flannel coral fleece throw will keep you cool and comfortable. During the winter, the flannel blanket also can be used as warm bed sheet or cozy sofa shawl.
Wash the blanket before the first use, add proper quantity soften detergent to avoid static.
